metadata.title: Secure Mobile

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing controlled, risk‑aware access to institutional services and data from mobile platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Mobile platforms, mobile operating systems, application containers, posture signals, threat telemetry, and access mediation.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite Zero Trust pattern governing mobile access through layered eligibility, application trust, data containment, and continuous risk evaluation.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Mobile aligns with NIST mobile security and Zero Trust guidance, explicitly excluding execution trust and privileged access from mobile platforms.

metadata.remarks: Secure Mobile composes all mobile security patterns into a coherent Zero Trust model. It defines how mobile devices may participate in institutional systems without granting execution or administrative trust. This composite establishes strict boundaries between mobile access, Secure Endpoint, and DAW environments.

components.title: Mobile Core
components.description: Defines baseline eligibility requirements for mobile devices prior to conditional access.

components.title: Mobile Application Trust
components.description: Defines which mobile applications are trusted to access institutional resources.

components.title: Mobile Data Containment
components.description: Constrains how trusted applications store, access, and share institutional data on mobile devices.

components.title: Mobile Posture & Compliance
components.description: Produces device posture and compliance signals for risk‑based access decisions.

components.title: Mobile Threat Protection
components.description: Detects mobile threats and generates normalized threat signals.

components.title: Mobile Telemetry Normalization
components.description: Normalizes mobile telemetry into decision‑grade security signals.

components.title: Mobile Privacy Boundaries
components.description: Enforces privacy and visibility limits between institutional controls and personal mobile data.

components.title: Mobile Admin / Break‑Glass Clarifier
components.description: Explicitly prohibits administrative and break‑glass access paths on mobile platforms.

components.title: Mobile Lifecycle
components.description: Governs enrollment, suspension, data removal, and decommissioning of mobile devices.
